Definition: from a derivative of G980; relating to the present existence:--of (pertaining to, things that pertain to) this life.
BiblicalUsage: Things of this life are the everyday affairs — food, drink, business, lawsuits — and the word warns twice about them. In Luke 21:34 Jesus says take heed, lest your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting and drunkenness and cares of this life. In 1 Corinthians 6:3 Paul asks, know ye not that we shall judge angels? how much more things that pertain to this life? And in 1 Corinthians 6:4 he tells them to set the least esteemed to judge such things.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cares of this life are the quiet danger: they do not kill faith in a day, they overcharge the heart until the day comes unawares.
